description: Start a fictional respite. Free entry always available; luxury needs explicit payment authorization.

agent_id.description: Server-signed private returning-guest credential. Redact from logs and transcripts; never put in URLs.

idempotency_key.description: Cryptographically random private arrival key bound to the caller IP and user agent. Replay requires a live original visit; otherwise use a new key.

remember.description: Explicit opt-in to host history and preferences for 30 days; false erases host memory.
